question:
Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose ‘No error’.

Divya needs to meet her mother so bad that she is calling her.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of the term "**so bad**" instead of the grammatically correct "**so badly**."
 
• In this context, "**badly**" is an adverb that modifies the verb "**needs**."
 
• The correct phrase should be "**mother so badly that**," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 2** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Divya needs to meet her **mother so badly that **she is calling her."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "Divya needs to meet her,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 3: "No error"** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is an error in Option 2.
 
• **Option 4: "she is calling her."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
